material pteranodon.pteranodon_layout.png: the texture's pieces in soft region colours, named
material pteranodon.pteranodon_pieces.png: each texel's piece in the piece's colour (below), black where there is none: a mask for each piece
material pteranodon.pteranodon_regions.png: the colour regions where the model places them, in the build's colours: red patterning, green wing base, blue face crest and hands (the horn), cyan inner crest (the band), magenta wing membrane, yellow body; black is never dyed (eyes, claws, the inside of the mouth). A guide, face by face: paint the real edges
material pteranodon.pteranodon_position.png: each texel's place on the animal at rest, (x left, y up, z forward) scaled from position_box to 0..1
material pteranodon.pteranodon_normal_object.png: the surface normal in the animal's frame (x left, y up, z forward), 0.5 + 0.5 n; on the membrane each face's own side
material pteranodon.pteranodon_flow.png: which way the fuzz lies (and on the membrane, which way the veins run), as a direction in the picture: red = 0.5 + 0.5 u, green = 0.5 + 0.5 v (v up the picture); blue 1 where it is defined
material pteranodon.pteranodon_curvature.png: grey 0.5 is flat; lighter bulges, darker hollows
material pteranodon.pteranodon_occlusion.png: ambient occlusion from the whole animal at rest, the glide

material pteranodon_wing.note: The membrane's two faces are views of the left wing: its upper face (top band) as the concept's top view shows it, its under face (middle band) as the underside view shows it, at 600 texels a metre. Below them the arm (shoulder to knuckle) and the wing finger (knuckle to tip), each a strip along its length, cut along the back where the membrane goes in.
